(async()=>{
/* One reader for every marketplace's search or list page. It reads only what is already on screen (no requests of its own)
   and returns every listing it sees: {site, blocked, rows:[{id, url, title, price_text, status, extra}]}.
   The Python step (goldstar.py) decides which rows are Japanese Gold Stars. */
await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500));
const H=location.hostname, T=document.title, B=document.body?document.body.innerText:'';
const clean=s=>(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
const blockedPage=/Just a moment|Security Measure|Medida de seguridad|Pardon Our Interruption|Access Denied|Attention Required/i.test(T+' '+B.slice(0,400))||/captcha|challenge|signin\./i.test(location.href);
if(blockedPage) return JSON.stringify({site:H,blocked:true,title:T});
const up=(el,re,n=5)=>{let p=el;for(let i=0;i<n&&p.parentElement;i++){p=p.parentElement;if(re.test(p.innerText))return p}return el};
const rows=[];const seen=new Set();
const add=(id,url,title,price,status,extra)=>{if(!id||seen.has(id))return;seen.add(id);rows.push({id:String(id),url,title:clean(title).slice(0,240),price_text:clean(price).slice(0,80),status:status||'on sale',extra:clean(extra||'').slice(0,240)})};
if(/ebay\./.test(H)){
  for(const li of document.querySelectorAll('ul.srp-results > li')){
    if(li.className.includes('srp-river-answer')){if(/menos palabras|fewer words/i.test(li.textContent))break;continue}
    const a=li.querySelector('a[href*="/itm/"]');if(!a)continue;const id=(a.href.match(/itm\/(\d+)/)||[])[1];
    const title=((li.querySelector('.s-card__title')||{}).textContent||'').replace(/Se abre en una nueva ventana o pestaña|Opens in a new window or tab/g,'').replace(/^Anuncio nuevo|^Nuevo anuncio/,'');
    const r=[...li.querySelectorAll('.s-card__attribute-row')].map(e=>clean(e.textContent));
    const price=r.find(x=>/^[\d.\s  ]*\d,\d{2}\s?EUR/.test(x)&&!/env[ií]o/i.test(x))||'';
    add(id,'https://www.ebay.es/itm/'+id,title,price,'on sale',r.filter(x=>x!==price).join(' | ')+' | '+clean((li.querySelector('.s-card__subtitle-row')||{}).textContent));
  }
} else if(/mercari\.com/.test(H)){
  for(const li of document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="item-cell"]')){
    const a=li.querySelector('a[href*="/item/"],a[href*="/shops/product/"]');if(!a)continue;const id=a.href.split('/').pop().split('?')[0];
    const t=clean(li.innerText);const pm=t.match(/¥\s?([\d,]+)/);const name=(li.querySelector('[data-testid="thumbnail-item-name"]')||{}).textContent||t.replace(/^¥\s?[\d,]+/,'');
    add(id,a.href.split('?')[0],name,pm?'¥'+pm[1]:'',/sold/i.test(li.innerHTML.slice(0,4000))&&/SOLD/.test(t)?'sold':'on sale','');
  }
} else if(/snkrdunk\.com/.test(H)){
  const used=/\/used\/?$/.test(location.pathname);
  if(used){
    const prod=clean((document.querySelector('h1')||{}).textContent)||T.replace(/の中古.*$/,'');
    for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/used/"]')){const m=a.href.match(/\/used\/(\d+)/);if(!m)continue;const t=clean(a.innerText);const pm=t.match(/([\d,]+)\s*\/\s*(\S+)/);
      add('snkr'+m[1],a.href.split('?')[0],prod+(pm?' ['+pm[2]+']':''),pm?'¥'+pm[1]:t,'on sale',pm?'condition or grade: '+pm[2]:'')}
  } else {
    for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/apparels/"]')){const m=a.href.match(/\/apparels\/(\d+)(?:\/used\/(\d+))?/);if(!m)continue;const t=clean(a.innerText);const pm=t.match(/¥\s?([\d,]+)/);
      add(m[2]?'snkr'+m[2]:'product'+m[1],a.href.split('?')[0],t.replace(/¥\s?[\d,]+.*/,'').replace(/^\d+\s/,''),pm?'¥'+pm[1]:'',m[2]?'on sale':'product page','product '+m[1])}
  }
} else if(/fril\.jp/.test(H)){
  for(const box of document.querySelectorAll('.item, .item-box')){const a=box.querySelector('a[href*="item.fril.jp"]');if(!a)continue;const id=a.href.split('/').pop().split('?')[0];const t=clean(box.innerText);const pm=t.match(/¥\s?([\d,]+)/);
    add(id,a.href.split('?')[0],t.replace(/SOLD OUT/,'').replace(/¥\s?[\d,]+.*$/,''),pm?'¥'+pm[1]:'',/SOLD OUT/.test(t)?'sold':'on sale','')}
} else if(/cardrush/.test(H)){
  for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/product/"]')){const m=a.href.match(/\/product\/(\d+)/);if(!m)continue;const box=up(a,/円/);const t=clean(box.innerText);const pm=t.match(/([\d,]+)円/);const st=t.match(/在庫数\s*(\d+)/);
    add('cr'+m[1],a.href.split('?')[0],t.replace(/[\d,]+円.*$/,''),pm?'¥'+pm[1]:'',(st&&+st[1]>0)?'on sale':'out of stock',st?'stock '+st[1]:t.slice(-40))}
} else if(/magi\.camp/.test(H)){
  for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/items/"]')){const m=a.href.match(/\/items\/(\d+)/);if(!m)continue;const box=up(a,/¥/);const t=clean(box.innerText);const pm=t.match(/¥\s?([\d,]+)/);
    add('magi'+m[1],a.href.split('?')[0],t.replace(/¥\s?[\d,]+.*$/,''),pm?'¥'+pm[1]:'',/SOLD|売り切れ|売切/.test(t)?'sold':'on sale','')}
} else if(/wallapop\.com/.test(H)){
  for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/item/"]')){if(!clean(a.innerText))continue;const id=(a.href.match(/-(\d+)(?:\?|$)/)||[])[1]||a.href;const box=up(a,/€/);const t=clean(box.innerText);const pm=t.match(/([\d.,]+)\s?€/);
    add('wp'+id,a.href.split('?')[0],clean(a.innerText),pm?pm[1]+' €':'',/vendido|reservado/i.test(t)?'sold or reserved':'on sale','')}
} else if(/vinted\./.test(H)){
  for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/items/"]')){const id=(a.href.match(/\/items\/(\d+)/)||[])[1];if(!id)continue;const t=clean(a.getAttribute('title')||a.innerText);const pm=t.match(/([\d.,]+)\s?€/g)||[];
    add('vi'+id,a.href.split('?')[0],t.split(', Marca:')[0],pm[0]||'','on sale',pm[1]?'price including Vinted buyer fee: '+pm[1]:'')}
}
return JSON.stringify({site:H,blocked:false,url:location.href,n:rows.length,rows});
})()
